comparison.objective: Assemble a compression pipe joint with the olive and nut in order and tighten it a turn past snug; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence loose fitting parts, insert pipe home, establish thread engagement, detect snug, and turn with a spanner versus loosen a captive setscrew, withdraw a hex bit, tune a collar, reacquire the socket, and cycle a fixture.
comparison.success_condition: Correct part order, full pipe insertion, and specified post-snug tightening define success; candidate requires repeatable bounded dynamic absorption and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve tightening, but compression-joint assembly tests part sequencing and leak-joint preload rather than adjustable damping behavior.
